questions.question: How should hooks run after a run event is saved?

options.label: Detached helper (Recommended)
options.description: After an event is saved, start a background helper. Never slows the run.
options.preview:
orchestrate done ──► save event
        │
        └─► spawn helper (detached) ──► fire hooks for new events

options.label: Inline, with a timeout
options.description: Fire hooks right after saving, in the same process, capped at a few seconds.

questions.question: Which moments should the built-in Slack notifier post?

options.label: All five (Recommended)
options.description: Run started, failed, finished, waiting on a question, waiting on a rate limit.

options.label: Only the three
options.description: Failed run, pending question, rate-limit wait.
